overview.title: Soft sand near town
overview.p1: Sfiha (often written Asfiha) is a soft-sand beach close to Al Hoceima, favoured by families and anyone who wants an easy sea day without the full width of Quemado.
overview.p2: Services appear in season. Outside peak months the strip is quieter and good for long walks along the water.
overview.p3: Use it as a second beach after Quemado, or as your main base if your stay is nearby.

q1.question: Sfiha vs Quemado?
q1.answer: Sfiha is often softer underfoot and slightly away from the main urban front; Quemado is the signature city beach.

q2.question: Facilities?
q2.answer: Seasonal; pack water and sun protection regardless.

q3.question: Safe for children?
q3.answer: Many families use it — still respect flags and conditions.

q4.question: How to get there?
q4.answer: Short taxi or local road from the centre.

q5.question: Best season?
q5.answer: Late spring through early autumn for swimming.
